description: This source file defines various option parsing callbacks and utility functions related to command-line options handling in a Git-like version control system. It includes functions to parse numerical options, object identifiers, commit references, and string lists, as well as functions to duplicate and concatenate option arrays.

methods.name: int parse_opt_abbrev_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses an abbreviation value from the command line options, ensuring it falls within valid bounds or defaults.

methods.name: int parse_opt_expiry_date_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses an expiration date argument, setting it to 'never' if unset, and validating the format.

methods.name: int parse_opt_color_flag_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a color flag argument ('always', 'auto', 'never') and sets the corresponding enum value.

methods.name: int parse_opt_verbosity_cb(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Adjusts verbosity level based on the command line argument, supporting --quiet and --verbose flags.

methods.name: int parse_opt_commits(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses commit object identifiers, converting them to commit structures and inserting into a list.

methods.name: int parse_opt_commit(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses a single commit object ID and assigns the corresponding commit object.

methods.name: int parse_opt_object_name(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses object names and appends their OIDs into an oid_array.

methods.name: int parse_opt_object_id(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses an object ID and assigns it to the target.

methods.name: int parse_opt_tertiary(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets an integer target to 1 or 2 based on whether the option is set or unset.

methods.name: struct:option * parse_options_dup(const struct option * o)
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of an options array.

methods.name: struct:option * parse_options_concat(const struct option * a,const struct option * b)
methods.description: Concatenates two options arrays into a new one.

methods.name: int parse_opt_string_list(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Adds a string argument to a string_list unless unset, in which case clears the list.

methods.name: int parse_opt_strvec(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Adds a string argument to a strvec unless unset, in which case clears the vector.

methods.name: int parse_opt_noop_cb(const struct option * opt UNUSED,const char * arg UNUSED,int unset UNUSED)
methods.description: A no-operation callback that always returns success.

methods.name: int recreate_opt(struct strbuf * sb,const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Builds a command-line style string from an option and optional argument.

methods.name: int parse_opt_passthru(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Recreates the option as a string and stores it in a string pointer.

methods.name: int parse_opt_passthru_argv(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Recreates the option as a string and pushes it into a vector of strings.

methods.name: int parse_opt_tracking_mode(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Sets tracking mode based on the argument ('direct', 'inherit') or defaults.
